hypothesis.name: H-PCX
hypothesis.claim: parity factors through a uniformly constructible public state of dimension and total cost polynomial in log(n)

recoverability_extension.name: H-RPCX
recoverability_extension.claim: the compact state is spanned by an effectively enumerable public feature family with polynomial descriptions and exact full-rank recoverability

promotion_rule: Do not promote to theorem until all proof obligations are discharged.
